text: Cognitive assessment in people with HIV may be confounded by psychosocial factors, especially those linked to childhood circumstances, which are rarely measured in studies investigating HIV effects on the brain. These factors may affect premorbid (pre-HIV) cognitive performance. We investigated how psychosocial factors influence premorbid cognitive performance in people with and without HIV.
source_label: The role of premorbid cognitive performance in the neuropsychological assessment of people with HIV in South Africa
